title: The Coefficient Choosing Game
blurb: Pick any commutative ring, $\mathbb{Z}/6$ or $\mathbb{F}_9$ or $\mathbb{Q}$, and take turns choosing the coefficients of a polynomial in any order. A wins if it has a root. Play computer Amog, who solves the small rings outright, or a friend online.

title: Fermimac
blurb: Zetamac for the roughly right. Guess $e^{1.4}$, $\pi(10^6)$ or the number of ants on Earth: one shot each, close enough counts. Feynman said he could get within 10% of anything; prove him right, on an online leaderboard.

title: Omegamac
blurb: Zetamac, continued to the end of the alphabet. Two minutes of arithmetic, powers, $\varphi(n)$, $\sigma(n)$, gcds, $\binom{n}{k}$ and derangements against the clock. Choose a preset or build your own, share it as a link, and try to beat your best.

title: Palinode
blurb: The evening post has arrived. Do a few favors, hold a few grudges, and see what gets lost in the mail. An unfolding game from an idea by Not the Pope Log.

title: Alchemy
blurb: A skyblock in the void, after SkyFactory 3. Start with one tree; compost, sieve and smelt your way up to auto-sieves, steel, heavy machinery and ore-growing crops, then transmute your way to the Terminal Object.

title: Coin Flip Court
blurb: Type in some coin flips or dice rolls, real or invented. The court runs a battery of randomness tests (runs, streaks, alternations, palindromes, repeats, sums) and tells you the most suspicious thing about them, with exact $p$-values.

title: The Blog
blurb: Math notes from the Institute: Dirichlet's theorem via Euler products, inclusion-exclusion on the way to Möbius, and an unintuitive guide to linear algebra where dimension is the length of the longest flag.

title: Dots & Boxes
blurb: Draw lines, close squares, get double-crossed. Play against Amog himself, who has read Berlekamp and will not hesitate.

title: Nim & Friends
blurb: Nim, Fibonacci Nim, Wythoff's queen, Kayles, Staircase Nim, Northcott's game, subtraction games and Blue-Red Hackenbush, against an Amog who plays perfectly. Set up your own starting positions, or turn on "show the math" to see why he wins.

title: Whack-a-Moni
blurb: You are Redstone. Moni keeps surfacing with a banana. Bonk him, build a combo, and under no circumstances bonk Megumin or Shiro.

title: Amog Space Program
blurb: An incremental game about rockets with real physics: the Tsiolkovsky equation, drag, staging. Start with a soda-bottle rocket, end with a colony ship to Andromeda.

title: Axis Order
blurb: The Axis Order incremental. Gather faith, spread pamphlets, and ascend until Amog I is satisfied.
